### What Determines Treatment Price?
Four factors mainly determine what you will pay: the treatment itself, the material or brand chosen (an entry-level Osstem implant costs less than a premium Straumann; composite veneers cost less than E-max porcelain), the number of teeth involved, and whether you book an individual treatment or an all-inclusive package that bundles hotel and transfers into one price.

### Why Is Dental Treatment Cheaper in Turkey?
Three structural factors drive the price difference: lower clinic overheads and property costs, significantly lower staff costs due to Turkey's cost of living, and a GBP/TRY exchange rate that has shifted substantially in favour of UK patients over the past decade. These savings are structural, not a sign of lower quality. Accredited Turkish clinics use the same implant brands (Straumann, Nobel Biocare) and porcelain systems (Ivoclar E-max) as UK practices.

### Package Inclusions
All-inclusive packages on this site bundle hotel accommodation and VIP airport/clinic transfers into the quoted price. Flights from the UK are always booked and paid for separately.

### Finance
Monthly payment plans start from £82/month with 0% interest over 12, 24 or 36 months.

### NHS England Charge Bands (April 2026)
Band 1: £27.90 (examination + X-ray). Band 2: £76.60 (fillings, root canal, extractions). Band 3: £306.80 (crowns, dentures, bridges). These bands cap NHS treatment costs per course of treatment; private prices above are entirely separate.

### FAQs

Q: How much do teeth cost in Turkey?
A: Individual treatments start from £130 for a zirconia crown, £190 for a porcelain (E-max) veneer, and £250 for a dental implant. Full packages start from £2,800 for a 20-crown Hollywood Smile and £5,600 for an All-on-6 full-arch implant package, both all-inclusive of hotel and transfers.

Q: What does a full set of "turkey teeth" cost?
A: The most common version is a 20-unit zirconia crown package at £2,800 all-inclusive of hotel and transfers, or £3,100 for 24 units. A full set of 20 E-max porcelain veneers is priced per tooth from £190, roughly £3,800 before travel. The equivalent UK private cost is £20,000–£30,000 for the crown package.

Q: How long does treatment in Turkey take?
A: Crowns and veneers are normally completed in a single trip of about 5 to 7 days. Dental implants need two trips — around 3–5 days for placement, then a 3 to 6 month healing period at home, then a second trip of about 3–4 days for the permanent crown or bridge.

Q: Do Turkey teeth packages include hotel and flights?
A: Package prices include hotel accommodation and VIP airport/clinic transfers. Flights are not included in any package price.

Q: Can I pay monthly for teeth in Turkey?
A: Yes. Monthly payment plans are available from £82/month with 0% interest over 12, 24 or 36 months.

## PAGE 2: Teeth in Turkey — Complete UK Patient Guide

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/teeth-in-turkey
Title: Teeth in Turkey: The Complete UK Patient Guide
Description: The complete guide to teeth in Turkey for UK patients: treatments, process, costs, safety, clinic evaluation, recovery and travel.

### Key Takeaways
- Dental treatment in Turkey typically costs 65–90% less than equivalent UK private dentistry.
- The most common treatments are veneers, zirconia crowns, dental implants, and full-arch restoration (All-on-4/All-on-6).
- Veneers/crowns typically need one trip of 5–7 days; implants and full-arch treatment typically need two trips a few months apart.
- Clinic accreditation (JCI or Turkish Ministry of Health certification) and the specific material/implant brand used are the two biggest factors in both safety and price.

### What "Turkey Teeth" Means
"Turkey teeth" is UK shorthand for dental treatment carried out in Turkey, most commonly veneers, zirconia crowns, dental implants, or full-mouth restorations. It covers a range of treatments, from a single crown to a full-mouth implant restoration.

### Why UK Patients Travel to Turkey for Dentistry
The primary driver is cost: private dental treatment in the UK — particularly implants, veneers and full-mouth work — is expensive, and NHS dentistry has limited availability for cosmetic and complex restorative work. Turkish clinics can offer the same categories of treatment, using internationally recognised materials and brands, at substantially lower prices, largely reflecting lower clinic overheads and labour costs rather than lower clinical standards.

### Treatment Overview

| Treatment | Typical Use | From |
|---|---|---|
| Porcelain (E-max) veneers | Cosmetic reshaping of healthy or lightly prepared teeth | £190/tooth |
| Zirconia crowns | Full-coverage restoration, used in Hollywood Smile packages | £130/tooth |
| Dental implants | Permanent replacement for a missing tooth root | £250 |
| All-on-4 / All-on-6 | Full-arch restoration for patients missing most/all teeth in an arch | £4,500/arch |
| Full smile makeover | Combined veneers, whitening and contouring in one plan | £3,500 |

### Stay Length

| Treatment | Trips Needed | Typical Stay |
|---|---|---|
| Veneers / crowns | 1 trip | 5–7 days |
| Single or multiple implants | 2 trips, ~3–6 months apart | 3–5 days, then 3–4 days |
| All-on-4 / All-on-6 | 2 trips, ~3–6 months apart | 5–7 days, then 3–4 days |
| Full smile makeover | 1 trip (varies by scope) | 5–7 days |

### Implant Brands Used in Turkey
Osstem (Korean-manufactured, entry-level), Medentika (Straumann Group), Straumann (premium Swiss), Nobel Biocare. Always confirm which specific brand is included in your quoted price — this is one of the biggest cost drivers.

### Safety
Safety in dental tourism is determined by the specific clinic and dentist, not by the country as a whole. JCI-accredited or Turkish Ministry of Health-certified clinics that use recognised material brands and follow standard sterilisation and surgical protocols carry a broadly comparable risk profile to equivalent private UK treatment.

### Dentist Qualifications
Dentists practising in Turkey hold Turkish Dental Association qualifications broadly equivalent to UK General Dental Council (GDC) registration. A dentist practising in Turkey is not automatically GDC-registered in the UK. Ask any clinic directly for their dentists' specific qualifications and registration details.

### FAQs

Q: Is it safe to get teeth done in Turkey?
A: Safety depends primarily on the individual clinic, not the country. JCI-accredited or Turkish Ministry of Health-certified clinics using recognised material brands and following standard clinical protocols carry broadly comparable risk profiles to equivalent private treatment in the UK.

Q: What happens if something goes wrong after I get home?
A: Reputable clinics offer a stated guarantee period on their clinical work and provide a way to raise issues remotely or arrange a return visit. Confirm exactly what a clinic's guarantee and aftercare process covers, in writing, before you book.

Q: Which Turkish clinics offer UK-based consultations?
A: Many Istanbul and Antalya clinics that work regularly with UK patients offer free remote consultations via video call before you travel. You submit X-rays and photos and discuss your treatment plan with the dentist or a treatment coordinator — no commitment required.

## PAGE 3: Veneers Turkey — From £190 Per Tooth

Title: Veneers Turkey – From £190 Per Tooth

### Types of Veneers Available

| Type | Description | Price (Turkey) |
|---|---|---|
| E-max Porcelain | Ultra-thin, incredibly strong lithium disilicate ceramic. Most natural-looking, high translucency. | From £220/tooth |
| Zirconia | Maximum durability. Ideal for patients who grind their teeth. Slightly less translucent but extremely strong. | From £250/tooth |
| Composite | More affordable, applied in single visit. Good for minor corrections but less durable than porcelain. | From £90/tooth |

### What Are Dental Veneers?
Dental veneers are ultra-thin porcelain or composite shells bonded to the front surface of your teeth. They correct discolouration, chips, gaps, and misalignment to create a perfectly uniform, bright smile. In Turkey, veneers are performed using the same global brand materials — primarily Ivoclar E-max and Vita porcelain — as the very best UK clinics. The dramatic price difference is due to Turkey's lower cost base, not any compromise in quality.

### The Veneer Procedure — Step by Step
1. Digital Smile Design — photographs your smile and creates a digital preview so you can see results before any work begins.
2. Tooth Preparation — a thin layer of enamel (0.3–0.5mm) is removed from the tooth surface to make room for the veneer.
3. Impressions & Temporaries — digital impressions sent to the in-house lab; temporary veneers protect your teeth while final ones are crafted.
4. Final Fitting — permanent veneers bonded with dental adhesive; fine adjustments made until bite and appearance are perfect.
5. Aftercare Guidance — full aftercare instructions and clinic contact details for any questions after you return home.

### Finance Options

| Package | Monthly | Term |
|---|---|---|
| 16 Veneers | £80/mo | 36 months |
| 20 Veneers | £106/mo | 36 months |
| 20 Veneers | £158/mo | 24 months |
| 20 Veneers | £317/mo | 12 months |

### FAQs

Q: How long do veneers last in Turkey?
A: E-max and porcelain veneers typically last 10–15 years with proper care. Partner clinics offer a 10-year structural guarantee on all veneer work.

Q: How many days do I need in Turkey for veneers?
A: You'll typically need 5–7 days — 2 days for preparation and temporaries, then 2–3 days later for fitting the final veneers.

Q: Are Turkish veneers the same quality as UK veneers?
A: Yes. Partner clinics use the same Ivoclar E-max and Vita porcelain materials as top UK practices. The difference is the cost of labour and clinic overheads, not the materials or skill.

## PAGE 4: Dental Implants Turkey — From £250

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/treatments/dental-implants-turkey
Title: Dental Implants Turkey – From £250
Description: Get permanent dental implants in Turkey from £250. Same Straumann and Nobel Biocare brands as UK at 90% less. JCI clinics, 10-year guarantee.

### Price Summary
- UK Price (per implant): £2,500 typical private
- Turkey Price (per implant): £250 — Save ~82%

### What Are Dental Implants?
A dental implant is a titanium post surgically placed into the jawbone to act as an artificial tooth root. Once healed (osseointegrated), a crown is attached to create a natural-looking, fully functional replacement tooth. Unlike dentures, implants are permanent and don't require removal.

### The Implant Process
1. Consultation & CBCT Scan — a 3D cone beam CT scan assesses bone density and plans exact implant placement.
2. Implant Placement — titanium implant placed under local anaesthetic; procedure takes 30–60 minutes per implant.
3. Osseointegration — over 3–6 months, bone fuses with the titanium; patient returns home with a temporary crown.
4. Crown Fitting — on second trip, permanent zirconia or porcelain crown fitted to implant post.
5. Aftercare — implants maintained like natural teeth: regular brushing, flossing, annual check-ups.

### Implant Brands Used
Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Astra Tech, Osstem — the same premium systems used in top UK practices.

### FAQs

Q: Are dental implants in Turkey safe?
A: Yes. Partner clinics use premium implant systems (Straumann, Nobel Biocare) and follow the same surgical protocols as UK clinics. All clinics are JCI-accredited or Ministry of Health certified.

Q: How many trips do I need to Turkey for implants?
A: Usually two trips. The first (3–5 days) is for implant placement. After 3–6 months of osseointegration, you return for the crown fitting (3–4 days). Some cases with good bone density can occasionally be completed in a single trip.

Q: How long do dental implants last?
A: With proper care, implants can last a lifetime. The crown on top may need replacing after 15–20 years. Clinics offer a 10-year guarantee on implant work.

## PAGE 5: Turkey Teeth — Veneers or Crowns?

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/turkey-teeth-veneers-or-crowns
Title: Turkey Teeth: Are They Veneers or Crowns, and How Much Tooth Gets Removed?
Description: Most Turkey teeth makeovers are crowns, not veneers. How much tooth each removes, what cannot be undone, and what to ask before you agree.

### Key Takeaways
- Veneer and crown are different treatments. Marketing language often blurs them; clinical reality does not.
- A veneer typically removes 0.3mm to 0.7mm from the front surface. A crown is reduced on all surfaces and goes into dentine.
- Enamel does not grow back. Every millimetre removed is permanent, for either treatment.
- A crown is the correct choice for a heavily filled, root treated, worn or broken tooth.
- Get the treatment plan in writing, per tooth, before any drilling.

### Quick Answer
Most full-mouth "Turkey teeth" makeovers are crowns, not veneers, even when they are advertised using the word veneers. A veneer removes roughly 0.3mm to 0.7mm from the front of the tooth and usually stays within enamel, while a crown is prepared on every surface and goes into dentine. Ask any clinic to state in writing which treatment each tooth is getting before you agree to anything.

### Veneer vs Crown Comparison

| Feature | Veneer | Crown |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | A thin shell bonded to the front of the tooth | A cap that covers the whole tooth |
| Tooth surfaces prepared | Mainly the front, sometimes the biting edge | All surfaces, all the way round |
| Typical enamel removed | About 0.3mm to 0.7mm | Substantially more, into dentine |
| Nerve risk | Lower | Higher, because preparation is deeper |
| Can it be undone | No, but the tooth keeps most of its structure | No — the tooth will always need a crown |
| Best for | Cosmetic change on healthy teeth | Damaged, worn or heavily restored teeth |

### Preparation Depth Ladder

| Option | Tooth removed | Layer reached | Best suited to |
|---|---|---|---|
| No-prep / minimal-prep veneer | ~0.3mm at most | Stays within enamel | Small shape or spacing changes on healthy, well-aligned teeth |
| Conventional porcelain (E-max) veneer | 0.3mm to 0.7mm from front surface | Usually stays within enamel | Colour, chips, minor alignment on structurally sound front teeth |
| Crown (zirconia or porcelain) | Reduction on every surface | Goes through enamel into dentine | Heavily filled, root-treated, broken or badly worn teeth |

### How to Tell What You Are Actually Being Quoted
- Look at the material wording. Zirconia is a crown material. If a quote says "zirconia veneers" or "20 zirconia crowns", that is crown work.
- Count the units against the teeth being changed. Full arch numbers such as 20 or 24 units usually indicate a full crown makeover.
- Ask for the preparation depth per tooth. A clinic planning conservative veneers can tell you it will stay within enamel.

### What Each Option Costs
A porcelain (E-max) veneer starts from £190 per tooth and a zirconia crown starts from £130 per tooth. Crowns being the cheaper unit is worth knowing, because it means a full crown makeover is not necessarily the more expensive plan, and cost alone should never decide which treatment your teeth need.

### FAQs

Q: Are Turkey teeth veneers or crowns?
A: In practice, most full-mouth "Turkey teeth" makeovers are crowns rather than veneers, even when marketed using the word veneers. A veneer is a thin shell bonded to the front of a tooth. A crown caps the entire tooth and requires reduction on every surface.

Q: How much tooth is shaved down for Turkey teeth?
A: A conventional porcelain veneer removes around 0.3mm to 0.7mm from the front, usually staying within enamel. A crown requires reduction on every surface and goes into dentine — the tooth is drilled down so it resembles a small peg.

Q: Can tooth shaving be reversed?
A: No. Enamel does not grow back, so any tooth structure removed for a veneer or a crown is gone permanently.

## PAGE 6: Dental Implants in Turkey — Complete Guide for UK Patients

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/dental-implants-turkey
Title: Dental Implants Turkey: Complete UK Guide 2026
Description: Dental implants in Turkey for UK patients: brands, procedure, healing times, All-on-4 and All-on-6, costs from £250, risks and clinic choice.

### Key Takeaways
- A single implant with a crown starts from £250 in Turkey vs £2,000–£3,000 in the UK.
- Full-mouth options (All-on-4 from £4,500/arch, All-on-6 from £5,600/arch) replace an entire arch of teeth on 4 or 6 implants.
- Most implant treatment plans need two separate trips to Turkey, roughly 3–6 months apart.
- Recognised international implant brands (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Osstem, Medentika) are used by accredited clinics in Turkey — the same brands placed in UK clinics.

### Implant Price Comparison

| Treatment | Turkey (from) | UK (typical) |
|---|---|---|
| Single Osstem implant + crown | £250 | £2,000–£3,000 |
| Single premium implant + crown (e.g. Straumann) | ~£800 | £3,000–£4,500 |
| All-on-4 (per arch, all-inclusive) | £4,500 | £15,000+ |
| All-on-6 (per arch, all-inclusive) | £5,600 | £15,000–£22,000 |

### What Are Dental Implants?
A dental implant is a titanium (or titanium-zirconium) post surgically placed into the jawbone to act as an artificial tooth root. Once it has fused with the bone, a crown, bridge, or full-arch prosthesis is attached on top, replacing one or more missing teeth. Dental implants in Turkey follow the same clinical principles used in UK and European dentistry.

### Implant Brands Used in Turkey
Osstem (Korean-manufactured, widely used as an accessible entry-level option), Medentika (part of the Straumann Group), Straumann (premium Swiss brand), Nobel Biocare. Always confirm in writing which specific brand is included in your quoted price.

### Full-Mouth Implants: All-on-4 / All-on-6
All-on-4 and All-on-6 use 4 or 6 strategically placed implants to support a full fixed arch of replacement teeth, rather than one implant per missing tooth. All-on-4 from £4,500 per arch and All-on-6 from £5,600 per arch, both quoted all-inclusive of hotel accommodation and VIP transfers.

Across both arches (full mouth): All-on-4 is £8,000–£11,000 and All-on-6 is £10,000–£14,000.

### Bone Grafting & Sinus Lifts
Where bone volume in the jaw is insufficient to support an implant, a bone graft can rebuild the site. For implants in the upper back jaw close to the sinus cavity, a sinus lift raises the sinus floor to create room for the implant. Both are additional procedures typically identified during diagnostics.

### Timeline & Number of Trips
Most implant patients travel to Turkey twice: once for implant placement and a temporary restoration (typically a 3–5 day trip), and again roughly 3–6 months later for the permanent restoration (typically a 3–4 day trip) once healing is complete.

### Questions to Ask a Clinic
- Which specific implant brand is included in this price, and is that stated in writing?
- Is a CT scan included in the diagnostic process before treatment is confirmed?
- Is the clinic JCI-accredited or certified by the Turkish Ministry of Health?
- What does the guarantee cover, and for how long?
- What happens if I have a problem after I return to the UK?
- Exactly what is included in the quoted price — hotel, transfers, temporary teeth, follow-up visits?

### FAQs

Q: How much do dental implants cost in Turkey?
A: A single Osstem implant with crown starts from £250, versus £2,000–£3,000 for an equivalent implant and crown in the UK. All-on-4 starts from £4,500 per arch and All-on-6 from £5,600 per arch.

Q: Are dental implants in Turkey safe?
A: Implant treatment carries the same clinical risks anywhere in the world. Choosing a JCI-accredited or Turkish Ministry of Health-certified clinic that uses recognised implant brands and follows standard surgical and infection-control protocols is the main safeguard.

Q: How many trips to Turkey do dental implants require?
A: Most implant treatment plans require two trips: an initial visit for implant placement (typically 3–5 days), followed by a second visit around 3–6 months later for the permanent crown or bridge (typically 3–4 days).

Q: What is the difference between All-on-4 and All-on-6?
A: All-on-4 replaces a full arch of teeth on 4 implants, while All-on-6 uses 6 implants for the same arch. All-on-6 generally offers greater load distribution and stability. Your consultation and diagnostics (including a CT scan) will determine which is appropriate.

## PAGE 7: Are Turkish Veneers Safe?

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/turkish-veneers-safety
Title: Are Turkish Veneers Safe? Risks, Tooth Shaving & How to Choose Safely
Description: A clinical safety guide for UK patients: what makes veneer treatment unsafe, what risks to look for, how to choose a safe clinic, and what to do if something goes wrong.

### Key Takeaways
- Turkish veneers are not inherently unsafe — poor provider choice causes most reported problems.
- The biggest clinical risk is excessive and irreversible tooth preparation beyond what the chosen restoration requires.
- Gum health and bite assessment must be completed before any preparation — a legitimate clinic will not skip this.
- Lab quality matters: in-house digital labs using pressed or milled E-max offer better quality control.
- Always receive temporary restorations before permanent preparation so you can review shape and shade.
- Confirm UK aftercare arrangements before booking — a named UK contact, not just a WhatsApp number for Turkey.

### Quick Answer
Veneers placed at accredited Turkish clinics by qualified dentists using established materials are clinically safe. The problems that appear in media reports and patient forums are caused by poor provider choice — not by Turkey as a destination. Excessive tooth preparation (irreversible), poor lab quality, inadequate diagnosis and absent aftercare are the main failure modes. Every one of these is avoidable by choosing a clinic correctly.

### Are Turkish Veneers Inherently Unsafe?
No. The clinical procedure for placing a porcelain veneer is the same in Turkey as in the UK. E-max (Ivoclar) and zirconia veneer materials used in Turkish clinics are the same brands used in UK practices. The problems that appear in news reports — teeth "shaved to pegs," cracked restorations, missing aftercare — are not caused by Turkey; they are caused by specific poorly chosen clinics.

### Why Problems Happen
Most reported problems with Turkish veneers fall into one of these categories:
- Wrong patient selection: veneers placed on teeth that were not suitable — unhealthy gums, untreated decay, significant bite problems — without prior diagnosis.
- Excessive tooth preparation: preparation depth appropriate for a crown applied to a patient who was quoted veneers.
- Poor lab work: restorations fabricated at low-cost external labs with inferior materials — incorrect shade, poor fit, thick margins.
- No diagnostic process: treatment proceeded without X-rays, a thorough bite assessment or gum health confirmation.
- No temporary restorations: teeth prepared and restorations bonded without the patient reviewing temporaries first.
- No aftercare: the patient returns to the UK with no named point of contact, no written care instructions and no clinical records.

### Excessive Tooth Preparation
This is the most serious clinical risk. The amount removed depends on the restoration type:
- E-max veneer: 0.3–0.5mm from the front surface only.
- Zirconia crown: 1.5–2.0mm from all surfaces.

Problems arise when clinics prepare teeth to crown depth when veneers have been quoted, leaving structurally weakened teeth prone to sensitivity, fracture and eventual root canal need.

### Questions to Ask Before Treatment
- What veneer material will be used — E-max, zirconia or composite?
- What is the preparation depth planned for my specific teeth?
- Will I receive temporary restorations so I can review the shape and shade?
- Who is making my veneers — in-house lab or external, and what equipment is used?
- Has a gum health and bite assessment been completed before any preparation?
- What is the aftercare protocol once I return to the UK?
- What is the warranty on the veneers, and what does it cover?

### If Something Goes Wrong
1. Document everything: photograph the problem, note the date and symptoms, keep all written communication with the Turkish clinic.
2. See a UK dentist: for clinical assessment. UK dentists will treat teeth regardless of where previous work was done.
3. Contact your Turkish clinic: a reputable clinic will respond to post-treatment issues, especially within the warranty period.
4. Claim on your travel insurance if your policy includes dental complications.
5. Seek legal advice if necessary for significant clinical harm caused by negligent treatment.

### FAQs

Q: Are veneers in Turkey safe?
A: Veneers placed at accredited Turkish clinics by qualified dentists using established materials (E-max by Ivoclar, zirconia by reputable manufacturers) are clinically safe. The risks that cause reported problems are associated with poor provider choice, not with Turkey as a country.

Q: What is the biggest risk with Turkish veneers?
A: The most serious clinical risk is excessive and irreversible tooth preparation — grinding down healthy natural tooth structure beyond what the chosen restoration requires. Once enamel is removed, it cannot be replaced.

Q: Will a UK dentist fix problems from Turkey veneers?
A: Yes — UK dentists are not obliged to refuse treatment on teeth worked on abroad. Most will assess, recement or replace a Turkish veneer.

Q: Do you need a gum health check before veneers?
A: Yes. Veneers placed on unhealthy gums can fail faster and carry a higher risk of gum recession. Any active gum disease should be treated before veneer treatment begins.

## PAGE 8: Best Veneers in Turkey — Types, Clinics, Costs & How to Choose

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/best-veneers-turkey
Title: Best Veneers in Turkey: Types, Clinics, Costs & How to Choose 2026
Description: E-max vs zirconia vs composite veneers in Turkey — which looks most natural, requires least tooth prep, and lasts longest — plus how to choose a good veneer clinic.

### Key Takeaways
- E-max porcelain is the gold standard for cosmetic front-tooth veneers: highest translucency, 15+ year lifespan, minimal tooth prep.
- Zirconia is stronger but more opaque — preferred for crowns and high-load situations, not front cosmetic veneers.
- Composite veneers (direct or lab-made) are reversible and less expensive, but lifespan is 5–12 years.
- The quality of the dentist and lab matters more than the material choice for final appearance.
- In Turkey, E-max and zirconia are priced similarly at £190–£250 per tooth.

### Quick Answer
E-max porcelain (by Ivoclar) is the best material for cosmetic front-tooth veneers in Turkey — it offers the highest translucency, the most natural appearance, requires the least tooth preparation of any permanent veneer, and lasts 15+ years. Zirconia is stronger but less translucent — better for crowns and back teeth than for cosmetic veneers. Composite veneers are less expensive and reversible, but wear faster. The veneer type matters less than the dentist and lab making it.

### Veneer Types Compared

| Type | Appearance | Tooth Prep | Lifespan | Cost (Turkey) | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E-max Porcelain | Most natural, high translucency | Minimal (0.3–0.5mm) | 15+ years | £190–£250/tooth | Cosmetic makeovers on healthy teeth |
| Zirconia | Very white, slightly less translucent | Moderate (0.5–1.0mm) | 15–20+ years | £190–£250/tooth | Crowns, back teeth, bruxism |
| Composite (direct) | Good but less lifelike | Minimal or none | 5–8 years | £80–£120/tooth | Budget option, younger patients |
| Composite (lab-made) | Better than direct composite | Minimal | 8–12 years | £120–£160/tooth | Step up from direct composite |

### Which Veneers Look Most Natural?
E-max lithium disilicate porcelain is the most natural-looking veneer material available. It contains a layered structure that transmits and scatters light in a way similar to natural tooth enamel, producing depth and translucency that zirconia cannot match. A well-made E-max veneer from a skilled dental technician can replicate natural appearance in a way that is undetectable at normal conversational distance.

### Which Require the Least Tooth Shaving?
In order from least to most tooth removal:
1. No-prep / ultra-thin veneers (0.0–0.2mm) — only appropriate where adding volume is needed.
2. E-max porcelain veneers (0.3–0.5mm) — the minimum for a porcelain veneer; irreversible but the least destructive permanent option.
3. Composite veneers lab-made (0.3–0.5mm) — similar prep to E-max.
4. Zirconia crowns (1.5–2.0mm from all surfaces) — significantly more tooth removal; irreversible.

### E-max vs Zirconia Veneers
The confusion is partly caused by Turkish clinics quoting "zirconium veneers" when they technically mean zirconia crowns (full-coverage caps, not veneers). The distinction matters clinically because it affects how much tooth is removed.

- E-max veneers: thin porcelain shells bonded to the front surface only. 0.3–0.5mm preparation. Natural appearance. 15+ years.
- Zirconia crowns (often called "zirconium veneers"): full-coverage caps requiring 1.5–2mm reduction on all tooth surfaces. Much stronger. Better for heavily restored, damaged or misaligned teeth. Less translucent.

### How Long Do Turkish Veneers Last?
E-max porcelain veneers placed correctly typically last 15–20 years before replacement is needed. Studies of lithium disilicate restorations show survival rates above 90% at 10 years when placed by an experienced dentist.

### Red Flags to Avoid
- A clinic that cannot confirm the veneer brand and material used in writing.
- No mention of temporary restorations in the treatment plan.
- Quote does not specify whether preparation is veneer or crown depth.
- No named UK aftercare contact offered.
- Pressure to pay a deposit before receiving a written treatment plan.

### FAQs

Q: What are the best veneers available in Turkey?
A: E-max (lithium disilicate porcelain by Ivoclar) is widely regarded as the gold standard for cosmetic veneers. It combines high translucency, long lifespan (15+ years), and minimal tooth preparation requirements. Zirconia is better for crowns and cases where greater strength is needed.

Q: Do Turkish veneers look natural?
A: E-max porcelain veneers from a skilled dentist and quality lab are indistinguishable from natural teeth in most cases. The material has a layered translucency that reflects light similarly to enamel. Quality of the dentist and lab matters more than the country.

Q: How much tooth is removed for veneers in Turkey?
A: E-max veneers require 0.3–0.5mm of enamel removal from the front surface. Crowns, which are often incorrectly described as "veneers", require 1.5–2mm removal from all surfaces.

Q: How long do veneers from Turkey last?
A: E-max porcelain veneers placed correctly typically last 15–20 years. Composite veneers last 5–12 years depending on whether they are direct or lab-made.

## PAGE 9: Turkey Teeth in Antalya — Complete UK Patient Guide

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/turkey-teeth-antalya
Title: Turkey Teeth in Antalya: Complete UK Patient Guide 2026
Description: What it is actually like to go to Antalya from the UK for dental treatment — treatment options, clinic choice, the patient journey, travel, safety and UK aftercare.

### Key Takeaways
- Antalya has more UK-focused dental clinics than anywhere else in Turkey — patient infrastructure is mature and English-speaking.
- Veneers and crowns: one trip of 5–7 days. Implants: two trips (placement + crown fitting 3–6 months apart).
- Direct flights from most UK airports — 4 hours from London, 4.5 from Manchester.
- Package prices typically include hotel and transfers but not flights — always confirm.
- Clinical standards at accredited Antalya clinics are equivalent to UK private treatment when the right implant and crown brands are used.

### Why UK Patients Choose Antalya
Antalya has been the primary destination for UK dental patients in Turkey for over fifteen years. Clinics here are structured for international patients — English-speaking coordinators, established hotel partnerships, airport pickup services, and treatment scheduling designed around a 5–7 day stay. The same E-max porcelain veneers and Straumann or Nobel Biocare implants used in UK private practices cost 65–80% less in Antalya, reflecting lower clinic overheads and cost of living.

### Treatment Options in Antalya
- Porcelain veneers (E-max): thin shells bonded to the front of natural teeth. Completed in one visit.
- Zirconia crowns: full-coverage caps over prepared natural teeth. The most common treatment in full-smile makeovers. Completed in one visit.
- Dental implants (single): a titanium post replacing a missing tooth root. Two visits required.
- All-on-4: four implant posts per arch supporting a fixed bridge of 10–14 teeth. Two visits required.
- All-on-6: six implant posts per arch for greater load distribution. Two visits required.
- Smile makeovers / Hollywood Smile: a combination of veneers, crowns and whitening across the visible smile. Completed in one visit for veneer/crown-only cases.

### The Patient Journey: A Typical Antalya Trip (Veneers/Crowns)
1. Arrival day: airport pickup, hotel check-in, brief welcome consultation.
2. Day 1 (clinic): full consultation, dental X-rays or CT scan, shade selection, treatment plan confirmation, consent.
3. Day 2–3: tooth preparation under local anaesthesia; temporaries fitted.
4. Day 3–4: lab turnaround day — rest, explore Antalya.
5. Day 4–5: final restorations fitted, bite check, adjustments, polishing.
6. Day 5–6: review appointment; any minor adjustments; departure.

### How Many Days Do You Need in Antalya?
- Veneers or crowns (up to 20 teeth): 5–7 days on one visit.
- Single implant: 5–7 days on visit one; 3–5 days on visit two.
- All-on-4 / All-on-6 (one arch): 6–8 days on visit one; 3–5 days on visit two.
- All-on-4 / All-on-6 (both arches): 7–9 days on visit one; 4–6 days on visit two.

### Travel & Logistics
- Flights: direct scheduled flights to Antalya Airport (AYT) from London Gatwick, London Stansted, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, Edinburgh and Glasgow.
- Airlines: easyJet, Ryanair, Jet2 and TUI. Return flights cost £80–£180 from most UK cities outside summer peak.
- Airport to clinic: 20–40 minute drive. Most clinic packages include airport pickup.
- Best time to travel: April–June and September–October offer comfortable temperatures (20–30°C), lower flight prices than summer peak, and full clinic availability.

### Hotels Near Clinics
Hotel costs near clinic partnerships run £40–£80 per room per night. Many packages include accommodation — confirm the number of nights.

### Paying for Treatment in Antalya
Treatment is quoted in GBP for UK patients. 0% representative APR finance is available — monthly payments start from approximately £70/month on a 36-month plan.

### FAQs

Q: How long do I need to stay in Antalya for veneers or crowns?
A: Most patients need 5–7 days: consultation and X-rays on day one; tooth preparation and temporary restorations on days two to three; lab work; final fitting on days four to six.

Q: Is it safe to get dental treatment in Antalya?
A: At accredited Antalya clinics using verified implant and veneer brands, clinical standards are equivalent to UK private treatment. The risks are associated with poorly chosen providers rather than with Antalya as a destination.

Q: Why choose Antalya for dental implants?
A: Cost saving (Osstem implants from £250 vs £2,000+ in the UK; Straumann from £800 vs £3,000+), availability of in-house CBCT scanners and digital workflows, and the resort environment that makes a 5–7 day first visit more comfortable.

## PAGE 10: Full Mouth Dental Implants Turkey Cost — All-on-4, All-on-6 & Full Arch Prices

URL: https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/full-mouth-dental-implants-turkey-cost
Title: Full Mouth Dental Implants Turkey Cost: All-on-4, All-on-6 & Full Arch Prices 2026
Description: Full mouth and full arch implant costs in Turkey 2026: All-on-4, All-on-6, titanium bar options, two-visit process and total package costs for UK patients.

### Key Takeaways
- All-on-4 per arch: £4,500–£5,500 in Turkey vs £12,000–£18,000 in the UK.
- All-on-6 per arch: from £5,600 in Turkey vs £15,000–£22,000 in the UK.
- Full mouth (both arches) All-on-4: £9,000–£11,000 treatment cost.
- Two visits to Turkey are required — implants placed on visit one, permanent bridge fitted on visit two.
- Temporary fixed teeth are provided on the first visit — you are never without teeth between visits.
- Implant brands used include Straumann, Nobel Biocare and MIS.

### Quick Answer
All-on-4 per arch in Turkey costs £4,500–£5,500; both arches (full mouth) costs £9,000–£11,000. All-on-6 per arch costs from £5,600; both arches from £11,200. All options require two visits. Add £400–£700 for two trips (flights, hotel, transfers) for total spend.

### Full Arch Price Comparison: Turkey vs UK

| Option | Implants | Bridge Type | Turkey | UK |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| All-on-4 — one arch | 4 | Zirconia / acrylic | £4,500–£5,500 | £12,000–£18,000 |
| All-on-6 — one arch | 6 | Zirconia / acrylic | From £5,600 | £15,000–£22,000 |
| All-on-4 — both arches | 8 total | Zirconia / acrylic | £9,000–£11,000 | £24,000–£36,000 |
| All-on-6 — both arches | 12 total | Zirconia / acrylic | From £11,200 | £30,000–£44,000 |
| Full mouth individual implants (8 per arch) | 16 total | Individual crowns | £6,720–£9,600 | £32,000–£48,000 |

### All-on-4: Cost & Process
All-on-4 places four dental implant posts in each arch at specific angles to maximise use of available bone. A fixed bridge of 10–14 teeth is secured to these four posts. It is the most widely performed full arch implant solution worldwide.

Turkey price per arch: £4,500–£5,500. UK equivalent: £12,000–£18,000 per arch. Saving: typically 65–75% vs UK private pricing.

On visit one, any remaining failing teeth are extracted, implant posts are placed, and a temporary fixed bridge is fitted. On visit two (3–6 months later), the permanent zirconia or acrylic bridge is fitted once CT scan confirms osseointegration.

### All-on-6: Cost & Process
All-on-6 uses six implant posts per arch. The additional posts distribute biting load more evenly and are often preferred where the patient has good bone volume and wants maximum long-term stability.

Turkey price per arch: from £5,600. UK equivalent: £15,000–£22,000 per arch.

### Full Mouth (Both Arches)
Full mouth implants means replacing all teeth in both the upper and lower arches. Both arches are treated simultaneously to reduce the number of trips required.

- Full mouth All-on-4 (both arches): £9,000–£11,000.
- Full mouth All-on-6 (both arches): from £11,200.
- UK equivalent: £24,000–£44,000 depending on configuration.

### Titanium Bar vs Zirconia Bridge
The permanent restoration can be either a full zirconia bridge or a titanium bar with acrylic/composite teeth. Zirconia is stronger, more stain-resistant, and offers a more natural appearance — preferred for most patients. A titanium bar with acrylic teeth is less expensive but requires the acrylic to be replaced or repaired over time. Confirm which type is included in your quote.

### Two Visits: What to Expect

**Visit 1 (5–7 days):** Consultation and CT scan; extraction of any remaining failing teeth; implant post placement under local anaesthesia; fitting of temporary fixed bridge. You fly home with fixed temporary teeth.

**Healing period (3–6 months):** Osseointegration — implant posts fuse to jawbone.

**Visit 2 (3–5 days):** CT scan to confirm integration; fitting and adjusting permanent zirconia bridge; final review before departure.

### Total Package Cost for Full Mouth All-on-4 (Both Arches)
- Treatment: £9,000–£11,000
- Flights (two return trips): £240–£360
- Hotel (two stays, combined 10–14 nights): £400–£700
- Transfers: £80–£120
- **Total: approximately £9,720–£12,180**

This compares to £24,000–£36,000 for the same treatment at a UK private implant centre.

### FAQs

Q: How much does All-on-4 cost in Turkey?
A: All-on-4 per arch in Turkey costs £4,500–£5,500. For both arches (full mouth), the total treatment cost is £9,000–£11,000. Add £400–£700 for two trips to get total spend. This compares to £12,000–£18,000 per arch in the UK.

Q: What is the difference between All-on-4 and All-on-6 for full mouth implants?
A: All-on-4 uses four implant posts per arch to support a fixed bridge; All-on-6 uses six. All-on-6 is typically recommended where bone volume allows, as additional anchor points distribute biting force more evenly.

Q: Do I need two trips to Turkey for full mouth implants?
A: Yes. Full arch implant treatment requires two visits: the first for implant placement (and any extractions), during which temporary teeth are fitted; the second visit 3–6 months later for fitting the permanent bridge once osseointegration is confirmed. You are never without teeth between visits.

Q: What is a titanium bar implant bridge?
A: A titanium bar (or titanium framework) is an alternative to a zirconia bridge for All-on-4 or All-on-6 arch reconstruction. It provides the structural foundation with acrylic or composite teeth attached. A full zirconia bridge is stronger, more natural-looking, and preferred for most patients where the budget allows.
